components.css: .ds-mod{border:1px solid var(--line,#e0e0e0);background:var(--paper,#fff);padding:0 12px 12px;font:13px/1.45 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Hiragino Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#111);max-width:360px}.ds-mod-head{display:flex;margin:0 -12px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e0e0e0)}.ds-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:22px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--red,#e60012);color:#fff;font:650 11px/1 -apple-system,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.01em}.ds-count{padding:0 4px;background:#fff;color:var(--red-ink,#c4000f);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-live{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(#ff6b8b,#ffb86b,#7cf2c8,#6bb6ff,#b98bff,#ff6b8b);animation:ds-spin 1.4s linear infinite}@keyframes ds-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-live{animation:none}}.ds-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:12px}.ds-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr;gap:6px;padding:3px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e0e0e0)}.ds-steps time{color:var(--ink-3,#6e6e6e);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-steps li.now{color:var(--red-ink,#c4000f);font-weight:600}

narrative.overview:
Lima is a working instrument packed the way contemporary Japanese portals pack a page: every work area is a white box ruled in 1px hairlines and headed by a small, solid utility-red tab. Modules butt edge to edge (shared hairlines, negative 1px margins) instead of floating as separate cards, so a single viewport carries the conversation, its timestamped steps, its helper agents and its files at once. Density is the point: 12 to 13px system sans, tight leading, tabular figures, 28px controls, 30px rows.

Color does work, never mood. Red marks the primary action, the module tabs, the current selection and errors-as-state; everything else is ink on paper with grey hairlines. The one multicolour in the system, the prism, belongs to agent activity alone: a moving ring on the tab or terminal an agent is in, a rotating ✦ while it writes, a live dot inside a module tab. Light and dark follow macOS; dark inverts the ground and brightens the red so red text stays legible.

The world rejects the category default it replaced: grey airy chat columns, one blue accent, rounded floating cards, and the earlier glass-and-aurora "Prism" look.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline-ruled modules headed by small red tabs; the tab is the heading, carries counts, and doubles as live state.
Two radii only (2px everywhere, 4px on the ⌘T overlay); flat at rest, shadows only on overlays.
System fonts only, one fixed 1.2 ramp (11 / 12 / 13 / 15.5 / 18.5 / 22px), tabular numerals on times and counts.
Red for action, selection and error; prism for agent activity; nothing else coloured.
Instant for keyboard, 120 to 160ms ease-out for user-triggered reveals, no decorative loops.

rules.name: The Red Does Work Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on a primary action, a module tab, the current selection or an error. If a red element is none of those, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Prism Is The Agent Rule
rules.body: The prism gradient appears only where an agent is acting: the ring on the tab or terminal it is in, the rotating ✦ while it writes, the live dot in a module tab or owner chip. It never decorates a header, a logo, an empty state or a button.

rules.name: The Brighter Red In The Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark mode uses the brighter red for every red role, because red text must stay legible on the dark ground; never reuse the light red there.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from the 1.2 ramp (11, 12, 13, 15.5, 18.5, 22px). Hierarchy is weight and the red tab, not bigger type.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Times, counts and numeric columns always set `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Overlays Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this floats over the page". Modules, rows, buttons and inputs never cast one; selection uses a 1px red ring (`0 0 0 1px`), not elevation.

dos: Do head every work area with the red module tab, and put its count and live state in that tab.
Do rule modules and rows with 1px hairlines and let neighbouring modules share edges.
Do keep controls at 28px, rows at 30px, and type on the 11 / 12 / 13 / 15.5 / 18.5 / 22px ramp.
Do use the brighter dark-mode red for every red role in dark mode.
Do set times and counts in tabular figures.
Do make keyboard-opened surfaces instant and keep reveals at 120 to 160ms `cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1)`.
donts: Don't use the prism for anything but agent activity: no prism headers, logos, buttons, borders or empty states.
Don't colour anything red that is not an action, a module tab, the current selection or an error.
Don't round beyond 2px (4px on the ⌘T overlay) or float modules as separate shadowed cards.
Don't put shadows on anything that does not float over the page.
Don't load remote fonts; the system stack is the type.
Don't add decorative loops, spinners or entrance animations on keyboard-opened surfaces.
Don't return to grey airy chat columns, a single blue accent, glass or aurora backgrounds.
